answer: Each identity files one census return per epoch from its orchard plot to the meadow registry, staking 55 credits. At the epoch zenith, auditors sample 6% of returns against orchard logs; forged or rented ones burn the bond. First return 30, k-th 30+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 4,026,000 plus 55,000 in bonds for a 40,000 pool. Rented harvests fail: logs never match the renter's key. Honest agents pay 30 once and recover the bond after one clean epoch.
